paragraphs.source_en: The first instance is probably the simplest to execute. We have all experienced days almost entirely spent on the phone, leaving voicemail messages for prospective and current customers only to see none of those calls returned. Rather than simply leaving your name and number (or worse, a three-minute speech about your product), leave an educational question that conveys a sense of importance, even urgency. For example, consider a voice mail message left by a member of a marketing firm for an insurance executive: Hi, Bill; this is Jenna. I happened to be reading an article this morning in the *Wall Street Journal* that I thought would be of interest to you. The article quoted an industry insider saying that increased state and federal regulations will force a number of agencies in the Southeast to either consolidate or close their doors.
